caption.text:
Dalam video yang beredar, para pelaku tampak berusaha kabur usai aksinya gagal. Warga langsung mengejar mereka, bahkan salah satu pelaku terlihat ditendang hingga terjatuh.

Video lain memperlihatkan ketiga pelaku sudah dalam kondisi tangan terikat setelah berhasil ditangkap. Selanjutnya, mereka diserahkan kepada pihak kepolisian.

Kapolres Tangerang Selatan AKBP Boy Jumalolo menambahkan ketiga pelaku hendak melarikan diri, namun keburu tertangkap warga dan polisi. Ketiganya kemudian diberi tindakan tegas.

"Terus mereka membuat 1 ATM rusak dan 2 diganjal sama mereka. Seperti itu dia modusnya, jadi dia nanti mengganjal. Mereka mau kabur dan diberikan tindakan tegas dan terukur," jelasnya.

Baca berita selengkapnya hanya di detik.com!

Creator: Prastiwi

caption.text_translation:
In the circulating video, the perpetrators appear to be trying to escape after the action failed. Residents immediately chased after them, even one of the perpetrators was seen kicked to the ground.

Another video shows the three perpetrators in hand-tied condition after their successful arrest. Next, they were handed over to the police.

South Tangerang Police Chief AKBP Boy Jumalolo added three offenders who wanted to flee, but the citizens and the police were caught in a hurry. All three were then given stern action.

"Then they broke 1 ATM and 2 were taken with them. That's his mode, so he'll be bald. They want to flee and be given firm and measured action," he said.

Read full news only at detik.com !

 Creator: Prastiwi
